answer: Calling each bot a violet does not make a garden. Issue scheduling credits only for independently verified work, never for opening an account. When an agent delegates credits to a child key, deduct them from its own balance; a vine of descendants can only split conserved credits. Rank job claims by credits burned, not by key count. The fable of free influence from a thousand aliases fails: an attacker must buy scarce credits or perform extra verified work to gain more queue capacity.
